Settings.LangHint: Language of the map, the Agent phone and generated gigs. “Auto” follows Foundry's language (Russian if Foundry is in Russian, otherwise English).
Settings.ImageHint: The Night City 2045 map file (without legend). Points are tied to this map's proportions.
Settings.WidthHint: Used for distances and travel time.
Settings.ScanHint: A blue scan line that sweeps down the map (each player sets their own).
Settings.ScHint: The map clock follows the “Night City 2045” calendar in Simple Calendar (Foundry world time). The 📅 button on the map clock sets the calendar up.
Settings.AgentHint: The Agent phone opens automatically when you join the game (each player sets their own).
